Delhi Government Proposes Expansion of Medical College Seats

The Delhi government has proposed adding 300 new MBBS seats and 103 Postgraduate (PG) and Diplomate of National Board (DNB) seats across its medical colleges. This expansion is planned in phases to enhance medical education within the city. The proposal aims to increase the overall capacity for training doctors.
